title: CH: priority review packets with exact heads and remaining work
public_pr_body:
CH expands tests/REVIEW-PACKETS-NEXT.md from 11 packets to all 148 open PRs in the 4 November metadata snapshot. Each packet has the full head SHA, actual PR-triggered CI run IDs/status, concrete reviewer checks and verdict question. No comments or review verdicts were posted.

Exact CH head companion: e40f9edb24a79769efd03b8f900c6c31d8a6729b. All 148 packet/head/CI fields checked. CI run 41826384400: success; documentation only, no suites or broad audits run. Moved heads, this self-reporting head and the CL follow-up are refreshed by tests/HANDOVER-BUILDER-3.md on coordination #271; recheck live heads before pasting.

Carries updated CJ and CG/CK evidence forward in the existing draft stack. Historical audit stays stopped at 52/61. No main merge, Ready label or production SQL.

- [x] Paste-ready packets, heads, CI IDs and reviewer checks
- [ ] Independent reviews and actual unresolved runtime proofs
